response.sql: SELECT m.member_id, m.position, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Share is expressed as a fraction (0 to 1) of the total of all counts, not a percentage.
